entries.question: How do I pay?
entries.answer: Checkout issues a live invoice payable in Bitcoin, USDT (ERC-20), or USDC (ERC-20) — no card details are ever requested. The price is locked for 15 minutes and the invoice page tracks network confirmations in real time.

entries.question: Why must I send the exact quoted amount?
entries.answer: Each invoice carries a unique quoted amount for its asset and network — that is how your payment is matched to your order automatically. Send exactly what the invoice shows, on the network it shows, before the 15-minute price lock expires. Never substitute a rounded amount.

entries.question: How do I check my order or license status?
entries.answer: Your invoice page tracks network confirmations in real time, and you can look up a license from the License page. I can't see account or payment state from this public chat, so for anything stuck, message the team with your order reference — never share wallet keys or full transaction credentials.
